title: The Attention Tax: How 5-Second Distractions Cost You 23 Minutes

Research shows it takes an average of twenty-three minutes to fully regain deep concentration after a single interruption. Checking your phone for five seconds never costs five seconds.

Most people spend eight hours at a desk sliced into forty tiny interrupted slivers, wondering why they feel exhausted with nothing meaningful finished. Two unbroken ninety-minute blocks beat eight scattered hours.
